description:
# Check: upstream fuzzy.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/fuzzy.test.ts

## Subject
Fuzzy matching and filtering algorithm.

## Upstream test count (approx)
11

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- empty query matches everything with score 0
- query longer than text does not match
- exact match has good score (negative value — more negative is better)
- characters must appear in order
- case insensitive matching
- consecutive matches score better than scattered matches
- word boundary matches score better
- matches swapped alphanumeric tokens (e.g., "codex52" matches "gpt-5.2-codex")
- empty query returns all items unchanged
- filters out non-matching items
- sorts results by match quality
- works with custom getText function

## Upstream dependencies
fuzzyMatch, fuzzyFilter from ../src/fuzzy.js

## Upstream notes
fuzzyMatch returns {matches: boolean, score: number}. Score is negative for better matches. Word boundary detection favors word-boundary results. Elixir port may return {:ok, score} or similar — verify *semantics* of ordering.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/fuzzy_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket (if needed) must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/fuzzy.test.ts (12 assertions across 2 describes)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/fuzzy_test.exs (16 tests)

## MAPPED

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| empty query matches everything with score 0 | "empty query matches everything" (asserts score 0.0) |
| query longer than text does not match | "query longer than text never matches" |
| characters must appear in order (incl. negative "cba") | "subsequence match" + "no match when characters not in order" |
| case insensitive matching | "case insensitive by default" |
| consecutive matches score better than scattered | "consecutive matches score better than gaps" |
| word boundary matches score better | "word boundary matches score better" |
| matches swapped alpha-numeric tokens ("codex52" vs "gpt-5.2-codex") | "swapped alpha-numeric query" |
| fuzzyFilter empty query returns all items unchanged | "filter/3 empty query returns all items" |
| fuzzyFilter filters out non-matching items | "filters non-matching items" |
| fuzzyFilter sorts results by match quality | "sorts by score ascending (best first)" |
| fuzzyFilter works with custom getText function | "accepts custom text extractor" |

## UNMAPPED

- Upstream "exact match has good score" asserts `score < 0` (signed bonus for consecutive chars). Our "exact match" test only asserts `matches: true` — does not verify the sign of the score. Indirectly covered by the consecutive/gap comparison, but the explicit invariant (exact-match score is strictly negative) is not asserted.

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir adds: whitespace-only query handling, swapped numeric-alpha direction, swapped-vs-direct penalty, space-separated tokens must all match. All beyond upstream scope; no action.

## Action

Creating one compliance ticket for the single missing assertion.
